say:1:1123306001:1.text: You're done already? Wait until I finish preparing the medicine. Just needs an extra dash...
say:1:1123306001:1.source_cn: 这么快就收好了？等我做完这些药。加上这味——

say:2:1123306002:1.text: The portions are good... Yes, that should suffice.

say:3:1123306003:1.text: These medicinal herbs could prove useful to a mage. Consider them a reward for your work earlier.
say:3:1123306003:1.source_cn: 这些药材，魔法师也会用得上的，就算是刚才的酬劳吧。
say:3:1123306003:1.male: These medicinal herbs could prove useful to a mage. Consider them a reward for your work earlier.
say:3:1123306003:1.female: These medicinal herbs could prove useful to a mage. Consider them a reward for your work earlier.

choice_prompt:4:1123306003.male: These medicinal herbs could prove useful to a mage. Consider them a reward for your work earlier.
choice_prompt:4:1123306003.female: These medicinal herbs could prove useful to a mage. Consider them a reward for your work earlier.

say:5:1123306004:1.text: I'll use most for healing salves.

say:6:1123306006:1.text: It's for the foolish youngsters who always forget to treat their wounds properly. The medicine will help fight infection and speed up recovery.
say:6:1123306006:1.source_cn: 是给那些蠢蛋年轻熊人准备的，他们总是忘记及时处理自己的...

say:8:1123306007:1.text: So, are they for the young warriors of the Grimmaw Clan?
say:8:1123306007:1.source_cn: 这些药是给黑嚎氏族的年轻战士准备的？

say:10:1123306009:1.text: I'm a bit tired now. Don't feel much like talking anymore. You all can go.
say:10:1123306009:1.source_cn: 我有些累了，不想再说什么，你们走吧。

say:11:1123306010:1.text: It seems the young warriors of the Grimmaw Clan have been training quite a lot recently...
say:11:1123306010:1.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族最近似乎在训练年轻的战士们呢……

say:12:1123306011:1.text: It's time for you to go! I need my rest!

choice:4:0:1.text: What are the remaining herbs for?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 剩下的药草会做些什么呢？
choice:4:0:1.male: What are the remaining herbs for?
choice:4:0:1.female: What are the remaining herbs for?

say:14:1123306005:1.text: Of course not. I don't need any medicine myself.
say:14:1123306005:1.source_cn: 当然不是，我自己也用不上什么伤药了。

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 这些药是给自己准备的吗？
